title: Hoist EmptyLoginScreen's getAllAccounts() future out of build()
why: future: is evaluated fresh on every rebuild of EmptyLoginScreen (theme change, locale change, any ancestor rebuild), so FutureBuilder restarts from its loading/no-data state each time, re-querying the device registry and making the account-switch icon flicker/disappear-and-reappear on unrelated rebuilds instead of staying stable.
recommendation: Move the Future into a @riverpod FutureProvider (e.g. allDeviceAccountsProvider) and ref.watch it, or cache it in a late final in a stateful wrapper.
acceptance_criteria: a widget test that triggers an unrelated rebuild of EmptyLoginScreen asserts getAllAccounts() is called exactly once, not once per rebuild
